ei.title: A Black Cat in a Dark Room
ei.subject: 9월_2024 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: A Black Cat in a Dark Room

fullPassage: Concepts are vital to human survival, but we must also be careful with them because concepts open the door to essentialism. They encourage us to see things that aren't present. Stuart Firestein opens his book, Ignorance, with an old proverb, "It is very difficult to find a black cat in a dark room, especially when there is no cat." This statement beautifully sums up the search for essences. History has many examples of scientists who searched fruitlessly for an essence because they used the wrong concept to guide their hypotheses. Firestein gives the example of luminiferous ether, a mysterious substance that was thought to fill the universe so that light would have a medium to move through. The ether was a black cat, writes Firestein, and physicists had been theorizing in a dark room, and then experimenting in it, looking for evidence of a cat that did not exist.

The ether was a black cat, writes Firestein, and physicists had been theorizing in a dark room, and then experimenting in it, looking for evidence of a cat that did not exist.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주제: 잘못된 개념이 존재하지 않는 본질을 좇게 만드는 위험
det.analysis:
① 잘못된 개념의 위험 - 글 전체 주제 <- 정답
② 고양이 찾는 방법 - 비유일 뿐 주제 아님
③ ether 물리적 특성 - 예시일 뿐
④ 과학책 고르는 기준 - 본문에 없음
det.tip: wrong concept -> chasing a nonexistent essence

ch: 잘못된 개념이 과학 탐구를 그릇된 방향으로 이끌 위험
어두운 방에서 검은 고양이를 찾는 방법

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지: 개념은 유용하나 없는 본질을 좇게 할 수 있어 조심해야 함
det.analysis:
① 항상 진실 -> 본질주의로 왜곡 가능, 오답
② 유용하지만 신중해야 함 - 핵심 메시지 <- 정답
③ 항상 올바른 가설 -> 잘못된 개념 사용, 오답
④ 속담이 방해 -> 속담은 통찰을 줌, 오답
det.tip: Concepts are vital, but be careful

ch: 개념은 유용하지만 존재하지 않는 본질을 좇게 할 수 있어 신중해야 한다.
